name: Illustration Rare Index, Scarlet & Violet
source: TCGplayer market, nightly buckets and hist-long
method: Every 7 days: total value and typical (middle, equal-weight) price of member cards with a real price that day (last point at most 8 days old). n = cards priced that day. No point with fewer than 5 priced cards. Nothing filled. Members are matched by card id and TCGplayer rarity.
